operations.description: Accumulate the input into the accumulator: this+0x1BC0 += a2 * 0.37.
Compute the clamp bounds from the reference at this+0x1C30: v2 = this+0x1C30 (lower bound) and v3 = this+0x1C30 + 0.4 (upper bound).
When the accumulator this+0x1BC0 is below the reference this+0x1C30, reset the accumulator to this+0x1C30.
When the accumulator this+0x1BC0 exceeds the upper bound this+0x1C30 + 0.4, cap the accumulator at this+0x1C30 + 0.4.
